events.title: Sculptures & Sips: Mechanical Reef
events.description: An immersive workshop where participants learn mechanical sculpture techniques inspired by the artistry of the Dead Puppet Society. Expect a hands-on session blending design, engineering, and creative play in a studio setting.

events.title: Wheel Taster – 2 Hours of Fun
events.description: A hands-on introductory pottery session focused on the fundamentals of wheel throwing in a community-minded studio environment. Perfect for beginners interested in exploring tactile craft and local maker culture.

events.title: Introduction to Crystal Singing Bowls Workshop
events.description: A hands-on workshop exploring the physics of sound and resonance through crystal singing bowls. Participants learn practical techniques for sound healing and sonic meditation in a focused, small-group setting.

events.title: Matcha and Ceramic Painting Workshop (Brisbane)
events.source: Matcha and Ceramic Painting Workshop Brisbane
events.description: A relaxed creative session combining the ritual of matcha preparation with ceramic painting. A social event designed for casual interaction while learning artistic techniques on pottery.

events.title: Warrajamba
events.description: An exhibition exploring the cultural and historical significance of the Warrajamba region. A great opportunity for thoughtful reflection on local history and heritage within a central cultural institution.

events.title: Jackie French Presents: Write Links Meeting
events.description: A gathering of writers featuring a presentation by author Jackie French. This is a community-oriented event ideal for those looking to engage with local literary culture and network with fellow creatives.

events.title: Acrylic Painting Techniques for Beginners
events.description: A hands-on workshop focused on developing fundamental acrylic painting skills in a supportive, small-class studio environment. Excellent for developing creative confidence and technical knowledge.

events.title: SNAP! (July)
events.description: A live, experimental improv comedy night performed by Improv Queensland. Expect a spontaneous, highly creative atmosphere in a well-loved local venue.

events.title: Growing Organic, Healthy Fruit Trees
events.description: A community workshop focused on the science and practice of organic fruit growing. Hosted in a garden setting, it's a practical, local-focused event for enthusiasts of sustainable agriculture and permaculture.

events.title: So, You Want to Storm a Trench?
events.location: Anzac Square Memorial Galleries, Brisbane City
events.description: A historical talk delving into the realities of trench warfare. This intellectual session offers deep insight into military history and human behavior during wartime, held at a significant memorial site.
